commonExpectations.success: ok true; transition is expected transition ID; revision increments exactly once; state changes, and Start also assigns actor to owner when unassigned; other task fields stay unchanged; refusals empty
commonExpectations.validRefusal: For well-typed guard failure: ok false, task unchanged, all failed guard IDs returned sorted. Invalid input returns INVALID_INPUT with nil task; known illegal pair returns ILLEGAL_TRANSITION.
commonExpectations.immutability: Adapter snapshots native input task and command, including slices and nested review data, and checks unchanged after each success and refusal; equivalent requests yield deep-equal responses.

modelChange.checks: generate each variant twice and compare artifact bytes; check decision table, transition and generated tests reflect change; run behavior against each variant

mutationExpectations: Removing G_revision fails stale command revision
Removing owner assignment fails start assignment; removing owner or actor guards fails missing owner at review submission or wrong owner actor
Allowing skipped transitions fails skip lifecycle
Removing G_reviewActor fails review actor mismatch
Removing G_independent fails owner reviews own task
Removing G_approved or G_changesRequested fails corresponding decision case
Failing to increment revision fails happy path
Nondeterministic generation fails model change regeneration check
status: Demo assumptions confirmed for this isolated demonstration; not production policy.

placeholderRules.$CURRENT_REVISION: Integer revision of the input task after all task overrides.
placeholderRules.$MODEL_DIGEST: Runtime model digest; adapter must provide its format and a distinct valid digest for negative cases.
placeholderRules.$OTHER_MODEL_DIGEST: A valid digest distinct from MODEL_DIGEST, supplied by the adapter according to the implementation digest format.
placeholderRules.$CURRENT_TASK_DIGEST: Digest of the current task under the specified canonical TaskDigest contract.

construction: Build task from baseTask plus state, revision and task overrides. Build command from defaults, apply reviewDefaults for approve/requestChanges, then apply command overrides. For review commands merge reviewTemplate, case review, and command.review in that order. Resolve placeholders after overrides using adapter-provided digest values; explicit literals are never replaced. Sequence steps use the preceding returned task.

versionExpectations.format: JSON v1 is the initial model format
versionExpectations.architecture: JSON v1 is initial transport only; parser and serializer map it to and from typed semantic IR, and shared validation and generators consume the IR. Replay provenance and validation trust boundaries must be explicit.
versionExpectations.versions: Report format, profile, and generator versions separately; do not conflate them.

unsettled: Other lifecycle and guard details remain provisional.
demoAssumptions: Start simulates assigning its named actor as owner when Ready is unassigned; otherwise the actor must match the owner. The named owner submits work for review.
A different named reviewer approves or requests changes; review binds task ID, current InReview revision, and model digest.
Well-formed custom guard IDs are allowed; unsupported operators, references and effects are rejected, and IDs are globally unique.
Each successful transition increments revision exactly once; rejection leaves the task unchanged.
Assignment is simulated example-only behavior, not a real claim or authorization mechanism.
Proposed review binding also includes a canonical digest of current task content; canonicalization and ABI remain pending.

staleTaskContentReview.status: TaskDigest ABI and canonicalization specified; exact refusal ID pending.
staleTaskContentReview.setup: Construct a valid InReview task and a valid review binding its task ID, revision, model digest, and canonical task-content digest. Change only one acceptance criterion in the task; retain the same ID and revision and retain the original review and all otherwise valid fields.
staleTaskContentReview.expect: Refuse due to stale task-content digest; leave task and command unchanged. The old digest must be well formed and was valid for the original content.
staleTaskContentReview.scope: Consistency checking only; this does not authenticate the reviewer or task.

goContract.revision: uint64; JSON fixture revisions are decimal strings; MaxUint64 refuses before increment
goContract.review: bind current task ID, revision, ModelDigest and TaskDigest
goContract.canonicalTaskDigest: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON, fixed key order id,state,revision,outcome,acceptance,owner; revision decimal string; nil acceptance as []; exact owner; Go encoding/json SetEscapeHTML(false), no trailing newline; valid UTF-8 without normalization
goContract.rawJSON: duplicate/unknown fields and raw malformed JSON pending an adapter contract

closedSemanticProfile.comparison: eq and ne compare same-type present operands; missing operand makes both false; a present blank string is not missing.
closedSemanticProfile.guards: Guard conjunction is unordered; report all failed IDs sorted.
closedSemanticProfile.start: G_actor requires nonempty actor; G_ownerCompatible requires absent owner or owner equal actor. Assign actor only if owner is absent.
closedSemanticProfile.review: G_reviewer requires nonempty reviewer; G_reviewActor is eq(reviewer,actor); G_independent is ne(reviewer,owner). Missing operands fail both eq and ne.

typedInputContract.invalidInput: Unknown state or trigger, invalid UTF-8, size bounds, blank acceptance elements, malformed supplied review digest or decision yield INVALID_INPUT and nil Task.
typedInputContract.wellTypedFailedGuard: Return unchanged task and all failed guard IDs sorted.
typedInputContract.illegalPair: Known illegal state/trigger pair yields ILLEGAL_TRANSITION.
typedInputContract.overflow: Check after guards and before effects.
typedInputContract.acceptance: Entries are required nonblank valid strings; duplicates allowed.
typedInputContract.json: No task/command JSON adapter exists; strict duplicate, unknown and missing field checks apply only to the model parser.

executionStatus: Catalog/design cases only. Local checker checks selected hand-written semantics; it is not a run of Go tests or an implementation.
caseExecutionPolicy: Only cases in sequences, refusals and special marked executable are registered and bound to full independent case literals by TestCatalogExercisedIDs. Pending cases require reasons; model-parser, regeneration, and mutation sections are separate plans.
